title: Thinking, Reading, Writing
label: ch:la-mind-verbs
canDo: I can say I think, I read, I understand and I write in Latin, produce the he-or-she form of each, and name the English words each verb built.

payoff.summary: The chapter closes on scrībō: after learning it the reader produces all four first-person forms and all four third-person forms in sequence — cōgitō, legō, intellegō, scrībō and cōgitat, legit, intellegit, scrībit.
